summary: A strong daily you can play by artist name: casual 7, fan 7, and every miss shows a figure (Pink #11, Guns N' Roses #12, Beyonce #13). Last cycle's "tour" leak is gone; only small matcher gaps remain for the queue.
reasons: Swift, Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Harry Styles and Elton John are gimmes, The Weeknd and U2 take thought, Springsteen and Metallica are fair stretches. Casual 7 (8 if they go back for Ed Sheeran's second offered tour); the fan also found 7 because they knew more legacy tours and spent lives on them.

Lives go fast (both players were out by guess 13), but on near misses that teach, each with a figure: Pink #11, Guns N' Roses #12, Beyonce #13, the Stones #16, Madonna $411M, Bruno Mars $396M. "tour", "world tour" and "concert tours" now hand over nothing, and every top-10 fact names the artist.
Deep Blitz: 19 of the 25 artists a casual fires off score. The blanks (Bad Bunny, Drake, Lady Gaga, Adele, Bieber, AC/DC) aren't on the source page and cost nothing.
fixes: Category words still hand over top-10 answers as a confirmable "did you mean" (src/game/match.ts, coordinator): "band", "bands" and "the band" offer #8 Springsteen and E Street Band 2023–2025 Tour, and "music" offers #2 Music of the Spheres World Tour. Add band, bands and music to GENERIC (or to the subject words of music lists); keep "e street band", "e street", "spheres" and "music of the spheres" working. Guard with a test on this list.

"styles" alone offers A Bigger Bang Tour / No Filter Tour (a two-letter misreading of the "Stones" alias), not Love On Tour. A player who means Harry Styles and doesn't know his tour's name can tap a Stones tour and lose a life. Add "Styles" on Love On Tour (a surname here, as "Sheeran" was added), so the exact surname beats the typo read.

Guesses that are on the list get "isn't an answer for this list" (free in classic, but the message is wrong and Blitz loses points): "elton" (#4, add "Elton"); "bts arirang" and "bts arirang world tour" (#19, though "bts" and "arirang" each work; flagged last cycle); "elevation", "u2 elevation" and "u2 zoo tv" (Elevation Tour and Zoo TV Tour are in the pool). Don't fix the U2 ones by adding a "U2" alias: it already has four owners and a fifth would drop it.
